data.description: Our 3 ft Curve Slide is a low red and yellow slide that bends to one side as the child comes down, with a short steel ladder at the back. The gentle turn adds a little excitement without much speed, which suits the youngest children in a nursery, play school or society toddler corner. A 3 ft height also lets parents and teachers reach the child at the top without climbing. The curve sends children out at an angle, so you can tuck the exit away from a walkway. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts against manufacturing defects. Tell us the age of the children who will use it and we will confirm the right height.

items.pText: Our 3 ft Curve Slide is a low red and yellow slide that bends to one side as the child comes down, with a short steel ladder at the back. The gentle turn adds a little excitement without much speed, which suits the youngest children in a nursery, play school or society toddler corner. A 3 ft height also lets parents and teachers reach the child at the top without climbing. The curve sends children out at an angle, so you can tuck the exit away from a walkway. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts against manufacturing defects. Tell us the age of the children who will use it and we will confirm the right height.

The steel ladder and supports are galvanised, and the slide bed is made from weather-proof, corrosion-resistant material. It can be set up self-standing or grouted in. Leave clear ground at the exit where the curve releases children, and check the ladder steps and slide joints during maintenance.
